{{Quote|Opur, make certain the children are secured somewhere. I don't want one hair on their little Jedi heads harmed.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|Talon Karrde and Opur|<ref name="Conquest" />}}
'''Opur''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as security officer on the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] during [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Invasion of Yavin 4|mission]] to rescue the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] from a [[Peace Brigade]] attack at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During the operation, Karrde ordered Opur to make sure the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] were secured, a task which he hurried to complete.<ref name="Conquest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Opur first appeared in the [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]'', written by [[Greg Keyes]].<ref name="Conquest" />
